title: Disable export button while exporting
description: The export button can be clicked twice and starts two exports. Acceptance: the export button is disabled while exporting.

title: Unknown project in list endpoint
description: The list endpoint returns an empty list for a project id that does not exist. Acceptance: list endpoint returns 404 for unknown project.

title: Show the last update date in the project list
description: Show the date of the last update next to each project in the list. Acceptance: each project row shows its last update date.

title: Retry failed webhook deliveries
description: Failed webhook deliveries are dropped. Acceptance: a failed delivery is retried three times.

description: Add a column `archived_at` to projects (migration) and show it in the list.
